summary: Rewrote runRepoChatWorker to use file-based response delivery: it now creates a temp response file path, prepends response-file instructions to the user prompt, runs the backend CLI, extracts cliSessionId from stdout JSON lines, reads the response file, runs repairResponseFile with resume-aware args when missing/empty, throws if still empty, and returns the file contents as text. Added guaranteed temp-file cleanup via finally so cleanup happens on success, timeout, and error paths. Verification: pnpm build and pnpm lint both passed.
